The '''Neo-Crusader War Forges''' were factories set up and operational on many worlds during the Mandalorian Wars.

==History==
Revolutionizing the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] war production, the Neo-Crusader War Forges were set up by [[Cassus Fett]] on planets the forces used as staging areas, including but not limited to [[Jebble]] and [[Tarnith]]. An important component in the success of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]], the War Forges mass produced armors, weapons and starships, ready to supply new recruits with equipment.<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
